# Claude Code Undocumented API and Betas

Claude Code talks to the Claude API and sends beta names with its requests.
Many of these names and fields are not in the official docs.
All 113 rows are found only in the program.
Anthropic can change or remove each item in any release.

## Found Only in the Program

113 items are in the program but not in the official docs.
These are the most useful ones.

- `effort`: The model accepts the `effort` setting. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `context_management`: The model works with the `context-management-2025-06-27` beta. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `--max-thinking-tokens`: A hidden flag that is deprecated. See [Models and API](Claude-Code-Models-And-API).
- `rejects_disabled_thinking`: Thinking cannot be turned off, as the docs say for `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS`. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `cc_entrypoint`: Where Claude Code runs, such as `cli`, `sdk-cli`, or `claude-vscode`. See [API Endpoints](Claude-Code-API-Endpoints).
- `org_locked_thinking`: The organization locks the thinking setting. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `silent_turn_reminder`: Claude Code adds a reminder after a turn with no text. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `adaptive_thinking`: The model accepts adaptive thinking. See [Models Capabilities](Claude-Code-Models-Capabilities).
- `--include-unsupported-models`: Offers models that your account can use and that this version does not know. See [Models and API](Claude-Code-Models-And-API).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY`: A gateway, which also needs `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and a token. See [Models Providers](Claude-Code-Models-Providers).
